narrative: Day 4 is a cold, clear Saturday. All HELIOS work is still office-based in Tashkent with no presence at the Qizilqum site yet. Helios EPC sets out its commercial and supply strategy: SCM issues the Procurement Plan and Package List, and Contracts issues the Subcontracting Strategy and Prequalification Criteria. Engineering and Construction send their one-page inputs for PEP Rev A to the Project Director ahead of the 7 December deadline.

tasks: Issue Rev A of the Procurement Plan and Package List: package breakdown (modules, trackers, inverter stations, BESS, MV/HV equipment, cables, civil, MMS, electrical and substation subcontracts), procurement strategy, long-lead items, RFQ dates, incoterms and logistics route to the Navoi site
Send procurement packages, vendor lead times and PO dates to the Planning Manager for the baseline L3 schedule (ACTIONS-000-007, due 8 Dec), aligned with M06 Module Supply Contract on 15 Feb 2027

must_produce.title: Procurement Plan and Package List
must_produce.notes: Packages, strategy, long-lead items, RFQ dates, incoterms, logistics

must_produce.title: Procurement packages, vendor lead times and PO dates for baseline L3 (ACTIONS-000-007)

tasks: Issue Rev A of the Subcontracting Strategy and Prequalification Criteria for the civil, MMS, electrical and substation/OHTL packages: contract forms, back-to-back FIDIC terms, local content, HSE/QA thresholds, financial capacity and bonding requirements (A710)
Ask SCM to align the subcontract package list with the procurement plan before prequalification questionnaires are issued

must_produce.title: Alignment of subcontract packages with Procurement Plan and prequalification timing

tasks: Answer the Project Director's request (REQ-003-epc-proj) with a one-page engineering and design management summary for PEP Rev A: design stages, OWE review cycle (10 working days for drawings and calculations) and the Basic Design route to M04

must_produce.title: PEP Rev A input - Engineering and design management summary

tasks: Answer the Project Director's request (REQ-003-epc-proj) with a one-page construction and site organisation summary for PEP Rev A: mobilisation sequence for M05 on 1 March 2027, temporary facilities and the Mon-Sat site works arrangement
Acknowledge the Planning Manager's request REQ-003-epc-plan and say that subcontractor mobilisation and duration assumptions will follow once the subcontracting strategy is issued

must_produce.title: PEP Rev A input - Construction and site organisation summary
Re: subcontractor mobilisation dates and duration assumptions for L3 validation

notes_for_log: Saturday office day; no event-engine happenings. Scripted deliverables issued: Procurement Plan and Package List (SCM, 4/01) and Subcontracting Strategy and Prequalification Criteria (Contracts, 14/01, A710 starts early). ACTIONS-000-007 input sent to planning. Engineering and Construction PEP Rev A inputs close the REQ-003 requests to the Project Director. A050 APG/advance payment planned start today; QSE comments on the APG forms are still due 7 Dec (ACT-002-KOM-01).
